name: Lemon Tycoon 8-Bit
description: Retro economic simulation tycoon game featuring an interactive 3D Minecraft voxel environment, multi-business expansion (Lemonade, Coffee, Ice Cream, Smoothies, Pizza), animated voxel customers (Steves, Alexes, Villagers), Game Boy chiptune audio, franchise automation, recipes, progressive tech tree, and dynamic weather.
